<summary>
Task: Answer 3 retrieval questions and write to /root/answer.json with token counts.

Q1: Employee IDs of authors and key reviewers of Market Research Report for CoachForce product.
Q2: Employee IDs of team members who provided insights on strengths/weaknesses of PersonalizeForce's competitor products.
Q3: Demo URLs shared by team members for PersonalizeForce's competitor products.

Data layout confirmed (Turn 1-2): /root/DATA has metadata/ (customers_data.json, employee.json, salesforce_team.json) and products/ (30 product JSONs). Each product JSON has slack, documents, meeting_transcripts, meeting_chats, urls, prs.

CoachForce investigation (Turns 3-12):
- 15 documents; first 3 are Market Research Report, all authored by eid_890654c4 (Julia Smith, Marketing Research Analyst). IDs: cofoaix_market_research_report, final_cofoaix_market_research_report, latest_cofoaix_market_research_report.
- Meeting transcript CoFoAIX_planning_1 (2026-04-15) is document_type "Market Research Report", participants: eid_99835861, eid_50da4819, eid_ee9ca887, eid_8df92d08, eid_85a4de81, eid_965867b8, eid_59bbe6f6.
- Transcript participants map to: Ian Jones, Hannah Miller, George Miller, Julia Garcia, Julia Davis, George Jones, Charlie Smith — all provided feedback in the meeting. Author Julia Smith (eid_890654c4) led the meeting.
- Likely Q1 answer set: eid_890654c4 (author) + the 7 reviewers eid_99835861, eid_50da4819, eid_ee9ca887, eid_8df92d08, eid_85a4de81, eid_965867b8, eid_59bbe6f6.

PersonalizeForce investigation (Turns 13-15):
- Documents include 2 Market Research Reports (author eid_a13234f2) and others.
- URLs include competitor demos: https://personaai.com/demo (PersonaAI), https://smartsuggest.com/demo (SmartSuggest), https://tailorai.com/demo (TailorAI).
- Slack search for strength/weakness/competitor/demo/personaai/smartsuggest/tailorai returned 36 messages. Identified speakers discussing competitor strengths/weaknesses:
  - eid_5318af37: TailorAI strengths (2026-05-15), PersonaAI demo share, SmartSuggest weaknesses (2026-06-27)
  - eid_fce6544f: PersonaAI weaknesses (2026-06-05)
  - eid_c9c3d8d5: SmartSuggest features (2026-05-19)
  - eid_d2f0f99a: PersonaAI features/weaknesses (2026-05-25)
  - eid_a253c65a: TailorAI weaknesses (2026-07-05), TailorAI demo share
  - eid_df282afb: commented on competitor analysis
  - eid_6c9bbe3a: commented
  - eid_caa2e58d, eid_2d8eff4d: acknowledgment comments
- Demo URLs shared for competitor products (Q3): eid_5318af37 shared https://personaai.com/demo; eid_1a7d9807 shared https://smartsuggest.com/demo; eid_a253c65a shared https://tailorai.com/demo. (Note: eid_2347b567 and eid_4df3bcc2 shared "our product demo" links, not competitor demos.)

Not yet done: haven't scanned meeting_chats/transcripts for PersonalizeForce competitor discussions, haven't finalized Q2 employee ID list, haven't written /root/answer.json yet, and haven't captured token counts.

Next steps for next round: consolidate Q2 list of employees who discussed competitor strengths/weaknesses (likely eid_5318af37, eid_fce6544f, eid_c9c3d8d5, eid_d2f0f99a, eid_a253c65a, possibly eid_df282afb, eid_6c9bbe3a); confirm Q3 competitor demo URL list = [personaai.com/demo, smartsuggest.com/demo, tailorai.com/demo]; write answer.json.
</summary>
